purpose: Replace three type-only collision labels with behavior-based names while preserving their legacy aliases.

promotions.name: PlayerCollision_SpawnVerticalResponseActor

contract.source: Clears the source actor and its owned resources
contract.response: Allocates a backward-slot Type-0x84 response actor, copies source X/Y, and subtracts 0x20 from Y
contract.timing: Sets the response delay at 0x00FFF124 to 8 and conditionally queues the response audio command

evidence: Direct calls to Actor_ClearOwnedResources, Actor_InitializeFromTemplate, and Actor_FindFreeSlotBackward
Direct Type-0x84 template load at 0x001AF1C4 and vertical offset write at 0x001AF1DA

promotions.name: ActorCollision_PrepareRecoveryPlane

contract.effect: Delegates to VDP_FillC000WithTileEEEE to fill VRAM C000 with tile word 0x0EEE
contract.role: Prepares the recovery display plane before the caller's VBlank and palette-reload sequence

evidence: Caller sequence at 0x001AE7CA-0x001AE7D2 performs the recovery preparation and VBlank/palette work

promotions.name: PlayerCollision_ReinitializeResponseActor

contract.dispatch: Shared player-collision entry for actor types 0x33, 0x38, and 0x39
contract.audio: Conditionally queues event 0x0B when SCENE_VDP_UPDATE_FLAG is set
contract.response: Adds 15 to ACTOR_RESPONSE_COUNTER, clears the current actor, and reinitializes it from ACTOR_TEMPLATE_COLLISION_RESPONSE

evidence: Exact 56-byte response block including the shared tail through RTS 0x001AF4D6
Direct calls to Interaction_AddResponseCounter15, Actor_ClearAndRelease, and Actor_InitializeFromTemplate
Type-0x5A, Type-0x5B, and Type-0x5C/0x5D cleanup paths transfer into this block

conclusion: The promoted names describe response allocation, recovery-plane preparation, and shared response-template reinitialization without discarding the original dispatch labels.
